title: Michaeas
summary: Raleigh names Michaeas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Michaeas, the Prophet who foretold Achab his death at Ramoth. Glycas so names the Prophet who reproued him. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IX, §. III, sig. 238a–238b
